heroHeadline: Kyiv Strike Death Toll Rises to 24 Including 3 Children; Ukraine Hits Ryazan Oil Refinery — 3 Killed; 257 Frontline Engagements
heroSubtitle: By May 15, the confirmed death toll from Russia's record May 13–14 aerial assault — 1,560+ drones and missiles in 30 hours — rose to 24 people including 3 children, with rescue teams still digging through a collapsed 9-storey Kyiv apartment building. Ukraine's drone forces commander Robert Brovdi confirmed a retaliatory overnight operation striking 23 military and industrial targets inside Russia, including the Rosneft-owned Ryazan oil refinery (~200 km from Moscow) where vacuum distillation units caught fire and 3 people were killed, 12 injured — the third Ukrainian strike on this facility in 2026. On the ground, the Ukrainian General Staff reported 257 combat engagements in 24 hours — the highest count of the week — with 1,150 Russian personnel killed or wounded and cumulative Russian losses reaching ~1,346,390. Diplomatically, Zelensky stated Ukraine is 'waiting on the US and Russia' to schedule the next peace round as the Kremlin reiterated maximalist demands including Ukrainian withdrawal from all four annexed oblasts, leaving talks at a full impasse.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, France 24, NPR, CNN, PBS, The Moscow Times, Al Arabiya, Kyiv Post, Euromaidan Press, EMPR Media, and Euronews. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
